2608.28515.title: Conformal Uncertainty Quantification Guarantees for Neural Operators
2608.28515.paper_summary: Neural operators provide fast surrogate models for approximating operators between function spaces, but their predictions often lack uncertainty quantification. We develop a split conformal framework to guarantee that a calibrated pointwise band around the neural operator output contains the true solution on at least a $1-γ$ fraction of the evaluation domain, with probability at least $1-α$ over test and calibration inputs, where $α,γ\in(0,1)$. Our method reduces a normalized residual field to its spatial $(1-γ)$-quantile and computes a scaling factor using a held-out calibration dataset. We prove marginal coverage guarantees for measurable residual fields defined on arbitrary probability spaces, covering both continuum domains and fixed discretizations. Under mild assumptions on the data distribution, we show that the coverage conditional on the calibration set follows a Beta distribution, which we verify with numerical experiments on Darcy flow and Navier--Stokes equations, where our calibration yields bands consistently tighter than existing corrections while retaining the target coverage.
2608.28515.paper_summary_zh: 神經運算子提供快速的替代模型，用於近似函數空間之間的運算子，但它們的預測通常缺乏不確定性量化。我們開發了一個分裂共形框架，以保證神經運算子輸出的校準點周圍的帶狀區域至少在 $1-γ$ 的評估域中包含真實解，並且在測試和校準輸入上以至少 $1-α$ 的概率成立，其中 $α,γ\in(0,1)$。我們的方法將標準化殘差場減少到其空間 $(1-γ)$-分位數，並使用保留的校準數據集計算縮放因子。我們證明了對於定義在任意概率空間上的可測殘差場的邊際覆蓋保證，涵蓋了連續域和固定的離散化。在對數據分佈的輕微假設下，我們顯示校準集的條件覆蓋遵循Beta分佈，並通過對達西流和納維–斯托克斯方程的數值實驗進行驗證，我們的校準產生的帶狀區域始終比現有的修正更緊湊，同時保持目標覆蓋。
2608.28515.author: Tom Stent et.al.
